Your everyday ritual

A simple moment of care.

Wet your skin and the soap, work into a gentle lather, massage over the body, then rinse thoroughly. Keep the bar dry between uses to help it last longer.

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
